detail: an engraved brass compass rose enclosing a weighted surveyor's plumb-bob and an open all-seeing eye, surrounded by sixteen graduation marks indexing degrees of epistemic certitude, stamped onto frontier boundary stones and embossed onto official Bureau seal-presses

evidence.quote: Operating model trace: one filename per chain, identical at every level. The compass that anchors position against drift.

facts.scale_ref: chiseled into milestone plinths and cast in relief on surveyor shoulder-clasps
facts.material: weathered naval brass, engraved copper inlay

note: The official emblem of the Bureau of the Unwritten Atlas, representing empirical measurement, unyielding canon, and protection against narrative drift.
